notes: Polyglot repo. Primary test surface is Python (pytest). Two package roots, each with its own venv: system/ml-service (featurizer suite; needs pandas+numpy, see requirements-test.txt) and system/shared/codegen/python (contract suite; needs the generated models via generate.sh). The TypeScript contract check is a compile-time tsc check at system/shared/codegen/typescript/test-contracts.ts, run via generate.sh + tsc, not a JS test runner.
